name: e2e-skills
description: Three agent skills for Playwright and Cypress end-to-end tests: generate new Playwright specs through the installed official Playwright agents with a short rules checklist and a scanner gate, review existing specs or PR diffs, and debug a failing test, fixing it safely (flake check, no product-code edits, no weakened assertions).

interface.longDescription: AI agent testing toolkit with three skills shared between Claude Code and Codex from ./skills/: playwright-test-generator (router: installed official Playwright agents with a short rules checklist prepended → e2e-reviewer scanner gate → scoped test execution; setup guide when the agents are missing), e2e-reviewer (static review of Playwright and Cypress specs or PR/diff-scoped test changes against 24 anti-patterns grouped P0/P1/P2 by severity — silent always-pass, poor diagnostics, maintenance) and e2e-debugger (thin debugger for one failing Playwright or Cypress test: three reruns with retries off to catch a flake, then splits the cause into app, test, flaky, environment or unclear; reports suspected app regressions without changing product code and repairs only test defects without weakening assertions). Use it for E2E test automation, Playwright test generation, Cypress test review, PR/diff review, failing-test debugging with safe repair, false-positive detection, and test smell scanning. Includes a standalone Node scanner (e2e-skills scan) for CI use without an agent runtime.
defaultPrompt: Generate Playwright E2E tests for a named page or flow with a scanner gate.
Review existing Playwright/Cypress specs or PR/diff-scoped test changes for 24 P0/P1/P2 anti-patterns.
Debug a failing Playwright/Cypress test and fix it safely; never edit product code.
